topic: Why Syndrome's Greatest Invention Wasn't His Technology. It Was His Revenge.
central_question: Why does someone who once idolized superheroes eventually dedicate his life to destroying them?
core_thesis: Buddy Pine begins as an adoring child who wants nothing more than to be Mr. Incredible's sidekick. When he is rejected, that emotional wound metastasizes into an obsession. As Syndrome, he claims he wants to make everyone super so that no one is special, but his elaborate staged attack on Metroville proves the opposite: he engineered a global threat solely so he could emerge as the world's most celebrated savior.
desired_viewer_reaction: His entire villain identity was built around one moment of rejection.
